args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
- corp.itsm: IT service management
- sap.ariba: Procurement/supply chain (vendor-facing)
- sap.s4: ERP (agents for orders, procurement matching; agents only)
- siemens.plm: PLM systems (agents only: BOM validation, supplier coordination)
- sap.ehs: Safety/EHS
- workday.hcm: HR/HCM
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors
- emarsys.cx: CX/engagement
- my.mes: MES (manufacturing execution)
- sap.crm: Sales/CRM (opportunity/campaign focused, NO order APIs)
- sap.odm: Entity type taxonomy

CAPABILITY GAPS IDENTIFIED:

1. SALES ORDER MANAGEMENT (confirmed gap):
- NO customer sales order management capability (access/retrieve/modify customer orders)
- Different from: purchase order management (vendor-facing), opportunity-to-order automation (creates orders)

2. PRODUCT COST ANALYTICS (NEW - confirmed gap):
Activity: "Understand which products are driving most cost; break down material expenses, design complexity, supplier cost benchmarking, supply chain risk"
- Siemens PLM: Has agents for BOM validation, supplier coordination, material provisioning - but AGENTS ONLY, no data APIs for cost analysis
- SAP Ariba: Has PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI, SourceingCampaignAPI - focused on procurement operations, NOT product cost analytics
- SAP S4: Has procurement matching agent, order automation - NOT cost analytics APIs
- NO analytics/BI system in landscape
- NO product cost reporting API found
- NO supplier benchmarking API found
- NO supply chain risk analytics API found

LANDSCAPE FOCUS:
- Operational automation via agents (PLM, S4, Ariba)
- Procurement transaction management (Ariba PO APIs, S4 procurement)
- BOM/supplier compliance workflows (PLM agents)
- NOT analytical/reporting on product costs, expenses, or benchmarking

args.reason: The landscape lacks product cost analytics capabilities; no resource provides cost breakdowns by product, material expense analysis, design complexity metrics, or supplier benchmarking—only procurement operations and BOM compliance agents exist.
